lead: Based on what you told me, your number one constraint is:
h1: Revenue has [[plateaued]], even though your traffic hasn’t slowed down.
fix_h: You don’t have a traffic problem. You need a system that **compounds revenue** from the traffic you’re already paying for.
zuck: You’ve probably filled enough of Zuckerberg’s pockets already.
lv_h: Three levers break a plateau without adding a single new visitor:
fan_tap: Tap the card for the next lever
lv1: **Get more people buying in the first 10 days.** Ask the people considering you why they bought or didn’t, and use it to go from 1 in 100 buyers to 5 in 100.
lv2: **Nurture non-buyers differently from buyers.** Non-buyers have unresolved objections, and a personalized 5-email objection sequence closes harder than one list for everyone.
lv3: **Go back to your existing buyers.** Repeat purchases, upsells, cross-sells, affiliate and seasonal campaigns all open up when they tell you what they want next.
lens: Through the **Revenue Per Visitor™** lens, this raises buyers in the first 14 days and revenue per subscriber. It sits in Compounding Revenue Per Subscriber™, quadrant 4 of the Compounding Revenue Per Visitor™ OS.
cta: Show me how to break my revenue plateau
up_next: Next question: What have you already tried to improve your revenue?
